title.en: Seevaka Chinthamani (சீவக சிந்தாமணி) by Thiruthakka Thevar

text.en: A hero's whole life is told as an epic.

Seevaka Chinthamani is one of the five great Tamil epics, composed by Thiruthakka Thevar. Sangam literature gave lyrical poems; later, epics arose that sing the life of a peerless hero. This epic has Seevakan as its hero.
The epic is known for its beautiful language and is called a 'gem of the Tamil language'. It is among the memorisation poems.
Terms: சீவகன் (the hero), காப்பியம், திருத்தக்கதேவர் and ஐம்பெருங்காப்பியம்.
